raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Description

**Bug:** Packed training of Qwen-VL models fails on transformers >= 5.16. Newer transformers pass the model's extra arguments on to the vision encoder, so the text sequence-packing settings reach it as well and clash with its own (`got multiple values for keyword argument 'max_length_q'`). Separately, `test_vlm_consistency` has been broken since <old PR that merged prev 1206>, because its mock data lacks `mm_token_type_ids`.

**Fix:**

- Strip the text packing settings before they reach the Qwen-VL vision encoder, which computes its own. No effect on transformers versions that don't pass them on (e.g. 5.3).
- Update the test: add `mm_token_type_ids`, use a realistic `[prompt][images][answer]` layout, and compare answer-token log-probs instead of raw logits. The raw-logit check fails on bf16 rounding even when packing is correct, and passed before only with a hand-picked seed. The new check still catches real packing bugs:

| Case | mean \|Δlogp\| |
| --- | --- |
| Correct packing | <= 0.06 |
| Bug: one packed sample attends to the previous one | 0.50-0.63 |
| Bug: 1D instead of 3D positions for images | 0.16-0.20 |

## Related Issue

Fixes #(issue)

- [x] 🐛 Bug fix

  [Contributing Guide](https://github.com/areal-project/community/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable; built with `./docs/build_all.sh`)
- [x] Branch is up to date with `main`
- [ ] Self-reviewed via `/review-pr` command
- [ ] This PR was created by a coding agent via `/create-pr`

**Breaking Change Details (if applicable):**

<!-- Describe what breaks and how users should migrate -->

## Additional Context

**Test results** (`python -m pytest tests/test_packed_vs_padded_consistency.py -v`):

| Hardware | transformers | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1x A100 | 5.3.0 | 2 passed, 2 failed (`KeyError`) | 4 passed |

detail.title: fix(engine): keep text packing kwargs out of Qwen-VL vision tower

files.patch:
@@ -224,6 +224,37 @@ def _prepare_multimodal_forward_inputs(
     _drop_multimodal_payloads(mb)
 
 
+# Packed-sequence metadata for the *text* tokens, added in ``_prepare_mb_list``.
+_TEXT_PACKING_KWARGS = (
+    "cu_seqlens",
+    "max_seqlen",
+    "cu_seq_lens_q",
+    "cu_seq_lens_k",
+    "max_length_q",
+    "max_length_k",
+)
+
+
+def _drop_text_packing_kwargs_hook(module, args, kwargs):
+    for key in _TEXT_PACKING_KWARGS:
+        kwargs.pop(key, None)
+    return args, kwargs
+
+
+def _isolate_vision_tower_from_text_packing_kwargs(model: torch.nn.Module) -> None:
+    """Keep text packing kwargs out of the Qwen-VL vision tower.
+
+    Since transformers 5.x (observed on 5.17), Qwen-VL forwards ``**kwargs`` into
+    the vision tower, whose helpers treat ``cu_seqlens``/``max_seqlen`` as
+    precomputed vision values and whose attention passes ``max_length_q`` twice.
+    """
+    inner = getattr(model, "model", model)
+    visual = getattr(inner, "visual", None)
+    if visual is None:
+        return
+    visual.register_forward_pre_hook(_drop_text_packing_kwargs_hook, with_kwargs=True)
+
+
 class FSDPEngine(TrainEngine):
     def __init__(self, config: TrainEngineConfig):
         self.config = config
@@ -1191,6 +1222,8 @@ def _create_device_model(self):
                 )
                 if self.config.disable_dropout:
                     disable_dropout_in_model(model)
+            if is_qwen_vl_model(self.model_config.model_type):
+                _isolate_vision_tower_from_text_packing_kwargs(model)
         else:
             self.tokenizer = load_hf_tokenizer(self.config.path)
             self.processor = None

@@ -12,6 +12,7 @@
 from areal.engine import FSDPEngine
 from areal.infra.platforms import current_platform
 from areal.utils.data import concat_padded_tensors, tensor_container_to
+from areal.utils.functional import gather_logprobs
 from areal.utils.hf_utils import load_hf_processor_and_tokenizer
 from areal.utils.network import find_free_ports
 from areal.utils.seeding import set_random_seed
@@ -175,16 +176,18 @@ def mock_padded_vlm_data(model_path):
             else processed_input["input_ids"]
         )
 
-        prompt_len = int(prompt_len) + int(image_input_id.shape[0])
+        text_prompt_len = int(prompt_len)
+        prompt_len = text_prompt_len + int(image_input_id.shape[0])
         ans_len = int(ans_len)
         total_len = prompt_len + ans_len
 
+        # Realistic layout: [text prompt][image tokens][text answer], loss on the
+        # answer only.
         input_ids = torch.cat(
             [
-                torch.randint(
-                    0, VOCAB_SIZE, size=(prompt_len + ans_len - len(image_input_id),)
-                ),
+                torch.randint(0, VOCAB_SIZE, size=(text_prompt_len,)),
                 image_input_id,
+                torch.randint(0, VOCAB_SIZE, size=(ans_len,)),
             ]
         )
 
@@ -199,6 +202,18 @@ def mock_padded_vlm_data(model_path):
             ],
         )
 
+        # Qwen-VL M-RoPE needs per-token modality types; text tokens are 0.
+        if "mm_token_type_ids" in processed_input:
+            image_token_types = processed_input["mm_token_type_ids"].reshape(-1)
+            dtype = image_token_types.dtype
+            seq["mm_token_type_ids"] = torch.cat(
+                [
+                    torch.zeros(text_prompt_len, dtype=dtype),
+                    image_token_types,
+                    torch.zeros(ans_len, dtype=dtype),
+                ]
+            ).unsqueeze(0)
+
         if "image_grid_thw" in processed_input:
             seq["multi_modal_input"][0]["image_grid_thw"] = processed_input[
                 "image_grid_thw"
@@ -242,6 +257,7 @@ def test_vlm_consistency(model_path):
         backend="fsdp:d1",
         path=model_path,
         dtype="bfloat16",
+        optimizer_dtype="bfloat16",
         attn_impl="flash_attention_2",
         gradient_checkpointing=False,
         disable_dropout=True,
@@ -295,7 +311,33 @@ def test_vlm_consistency(model_path):
             x2 = engine.model(**mb).logits.squeeze(0)[:-pad_len]
 
             assert x1.shape == x2.shape, f"Shape mismatch: {x1.shape} vs {x2.shape}"
-            assert_close(x1, x2, atol=2e-1, rtol=2e-1)
+
+            # Compare what training consumes: the log-prob of each answer token
+            # (loss_mask=1), scored from the previous position. An element-wise
+            # check on raw logits is too strict for VLMs: bf16 rounding from the
+            # different batch shapes moves a few of the ~150k logits per token
+            # past atol=0.2, even between two unpacked layouts. Measured on XPU
+            # (Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen3-VL-2B): correct packing stays within 0.30 max
+            # / 0.062 mean |dlogp|; removing a sequence boundary or using 1-D
+            # positions for images raises the mean to >= 0.15.
+            input_ids = torch.cat(
+                [padded_input["input_ids"][i, :s] for i, s in enumerate(seqlens)]
+            )
+            loss_mask = torch.cat(
+                [padded_input["loss_mask"][i, :s] for i, s in enumerate(seqlens)]
+            ).bool()
+            ends = torch.cumsum(seqlens, 0).tolist()
+            pred_pos = torch.cat(
+                [torch.arange(e - s, e - 1) for s, e in zip(seqlens.tolist(), ends)]
+            ).to(input_ids.device)
+            pred_pos = pred_pos[loss_mask[pred_pos + 1]]
+            labels = input_ids[pred_pos + 1]
+
+            logp_padded = gather_logprobs(x1[pred_pos].float(), labels)
+            logp_packed = gather_logprobs(x2[pred_pos].float(), labels)
+            assert_close(logp_packed, logp_padded, atol=5e-1, rtol=0)
+            mean_diff = (logp_packed - logp_padded).abs().mean().item()
+            assert mean_diff <= 1e-1, f"mean |dlogp| {mean_diff:.4f} > 0.1"
     finally:
         engine.destroy()
         assert not dist.is_initialized()
